title: ddc-elements/1 — one row of elements.parquet
description: Column set of elements.parquet. Physical types: strings for keys and text, float64 for quantities and bbox, int64 for count. The ERP stores every column as string (dataframe_store); the parquet written by the editor keeps native types. Columns not listed here are forbidden; extra data goes into props (JSON text).

id.description: == element_key. ERP join column (tiler, property panel).

stable_id.description: == element_key. ERP element identity across versions.

element_type.description: ERP category, e.g. Wall, Slab, Door.

type_key.description: Stable key of the element type (family/type).

space.description: element_key of the containing space, if any.

geometry_hash.description: SHA-256 (lower-case hex, 64 chars) of the canonical world-space triangle list, README s4. 16 to 64 chars are accepted so older hashes survive; the ERP only compares equality.

area_m2.description: Net area, one definition per class (README s4): IfcWall = one face, length x height less openings; IfcSlab/IfcRoof/IfcCovering = plan (horizontal projection) area; IfcSpace = net floor area; IfcWindow/IfcDoor = rough opening width x height; other classes = null unless the class README lists it.

props.description: JSON object text of remaining parameters (flat, string or number values).

space_usage.description: IfcSpace rows only: DIN 277-style use of the space. 'living' + dwelling membership defines the living-area basis (WFL); null on every other class and when the editor does not know.
